name: Cube-4/VolumePro Gradient Magnitude Approximation
definition: The resulting magnitude value serves as a measure of the 'strength' of a surface, where a high magnitude indicates a high probability of surface crossing.
summary: Cube-4/VolumePro Gradient Magnitude Approximation is a fast, cost-effective method for real-time volume rendering that estimates surface strength using central differences and a single Newton-Raphson iteration instead of exact Euclidean norms.
